sections.title: Sample and customer
sections.note: DRAFT ONLY. Not authorised for issue or an accreditation statement. Results relate only to this sample. Confirm report contents, methods, uncertainty and scope with the laboratory reviewer.
sections.sql: select s.code,s.name,c.name customer,s.matrix,s.collected_at,s.received_at,s.condition from samples s join customers c on c.id=s.customer_id where s.id=$1

sections.title: Latest recorded results
sections.note: Values and uncertainty use the recorded method unit. Recorded limits are a screening rule, not a conformity decision. Unreviewed results remain visible as drafts.
sections.sql: select t.code test,r.revision,r.value,r.uncertainty,r.method_snapshot->>'unit' unit,r.method_snapshot->>'code' method,r.method_snapshot->>'revision' method_revision,r.measured_at,r.qc,coalesce(v.reviewer,'UNREVIEWED') reviewer,r.raw_ref from tests t left join lateral(select * from results where test_id=t.id order by revision desc limit 1) r on true left join reviews v on v.result_id=r.id where t.sample_id=$1 order by t.code

sections.title: Open issues
sections.sql: select code,description,owner from issues where sample_id=$1 and closed_at is null

sections.title: Recorded movements
sections.sql: select happened_at,handler,location,note from custody where sample_id=$1 order by happened_at

sections.title: Issue and action
sections.sql: select i.code,s.code sample,i.description,i.owner,i.due_date,i.resolution,i.closed_at from issues i join samples s on s.id=i.sample_id where i.id=$1
